name: Pesticide (without hover bar)
summary: Injects colored outlines around every element to expose box-model spacing and nesting at a glance for CSS layout debugging, without altering hover styling.
browsersNote: AMO 'Pesticide' is a different project by another author; no Edge listing found.
license: AGPL-3.0 (stated on the store page; matches GitHub michaelkolesidis/pesticide-without-hover-bar).
goodFor: Seeing box-model outlines on every element to debug layout and spacing.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: pesticide box model outline grid layout debug spacing css
